entities.name: Bianca Bellová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bianca Bellová is a Czech writer. She was born in Prague. She has written a number of books: Sentimentální román, Mrtvý muž, Celý den se nic nestane, Jezero, Mona (2019) and Tyhle fragmenty. Jezero won the top Czech literary award Magnesia Litera and the EU Prize for Literature in 2016 and has been translated in numerous languages.
